name: design
description: Design planning (optional stage). Decides the UI approach, source, token and component strategies, decomposition axis, and review surface, and creates devflow/project/design.md. Use for design systems, UI style, or component-library decisions.
problem: Preserve the behavior of immutable repository sources `skills/design/SKILL.md` and `skills/design/SKILL_ko.md`, identified by their recorded source hashes, without silently changing their obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: A maintenance direction records its origin through split before ordinary design planning; durable research resumes through that same origin/card.
judgment_points: Record-first routing precedes design planning, and research never routes directly from a judged state to work.
